Tab. 6.17 Übersicht und Beschrieb der bilanzierten Ortbetonbohrpfähle; AVG: Durchschnitt
reason: The dataset is a single cased ('verrohrt'/piped) cast-in-place concrete pile of 880 mm diameter from the named site 'Integra L2 Wallisellen', reported per m of pile. Tab. 6.17 (p.37) is the overview that names and describes each of the inventoried Ortbetonbohrpfähle (cast-in-place bored piles) with their diameters, and Tab. 6.18 (p.38, continued on the same page) gives their inventory data per m of pile — one column per inventoried pile, so the 880 mm Wallisellen column must be read out of it. Tab. 6.14 is precast concrete piles, Tab. 6.16 micro-piles and Tab. 6.20 displacement piles, all different pile types.
